start.text: (A man with a torch and a bunch of keys, by the generator.) Who's that? — Oh. Top room. You're alive. I'm Suresh. The landlord. Her husband.

aunty.text: She went to the temple on Tuesday. (He looks at her door, at the slippers.) That's all.

light.text: UV. The BBMP put them up at the camps. They don't come into the purple. Don't ask me why — I don't care why.

rules.text: Rules. No noise after five. No lights facing the road. The generator runs the lamp, the lamp keeps us. Here — water, rice. And the lamp needs petrol. Whatever you find, it comes to the shelf.

manju.text: Manju is on the terrace with his table. He takes things now, not money. Your phone is a brick. (He goes back to the generator.)

again.text: Petrol, food, water. To the shelf. And quiet after five.
